verdict.rationale: Floot's docs say it turns a plain-language description into a real, deployed full-stack app. That app is a React + TypeScript frontend with backend endpoints, backed by a managed Postgres database, built-in OAuth sign-in and one-click publishing. Integrations are also built from a natural-language description into endpoints, tables and screens. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that generated apps actually work as claimed (all evidence is vendor documentation).
